_help: Fix a mis-routed command WITHOUT code or retraining. Each anchor forces a command to a specific intent/skill BEFORE the k-NN classifier runs. Add objects to 'anchors': {"signal": "<regex>", "intent": "<intent/skill name>", "exclude": "<optional regex>"}. If 'signal' matches the command AND 'exclude' does NOT, the command routes to 'intent'. Regexes are case-insensitive (Python re). Keep 'signal' specific so you don't over-catch. Find intent/skill names in docs/COMMANDS.md. Restart AERIS after editing. The built-in anchors (arithmetic, get_time, search_web, define_word, gcd_lcm, is-prime, reminder/kholo guards, text-case ops) are always active in addition to these.
